in_hindi.name: Spandan
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Explosion, Joy, Delight
in_hindi.long_meaning: Spandan एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Spandan means explosion or expansion in Sanskrit and Hindi. It signifies the feeling of pure joy and delight, as if an inner explosion of happiness has taken place. This name is often given to a baby girl as a symbol of the joy and excitement that her arrival brings.
